name: Crisis Mode
description: Module adds a configurable sitewide block in case of a crisis or emergency.
project_description:
This module provides a predefined and configurable block which can be easily enabled and disabled in case of a crisis or any other situation which needs immediate communication. 

 Usage 
 Configuration 
 
 Install the module as usual. A new block will be added to the content region. The Block is disabled and nothing will be shown on the website after installation. 
 Visit the configuration page /admin/config/system/crisis_mode 
 Configure as needed and save (caches will be cleared). 
 Done (as long as there is no crisis communication needed) 
 
 Activate the Crisis Situation 
 In order to activate the previously configured block you have two options:

 
 Visit the settings page mentioned above and tick the checkbox saying Crisis Situation . Save! 
 Use drush: drush crisis-mode on 
 
 Both methods will make the block visible and clear the caches. Untick the Crisis Situation to disable it again or use Drush: drush crisis-mode off .
